title: Late Sen. Santiago’s remarks played in VP Duterte impeachment trial
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The remarks of the late Sen. Miriam Defensor-Santiago criticizing the prosecution for withdrawing articles of impeachment during the trial of late Chief Justice Renato Corona…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The remarks of the late Sen. Miriam Defensor-Santiago criticizing the prosecution for withdrawing articles of impeachment during the trial of late Chief Justice Renato Corona were played on Wednesday before the Senate impeachment court. The video was presented by defense lawyer Mark Vinluan during the testimony of lawyer Reinel dela Fuente, a former investigator of the Anti-Money Laundering Council Secretariat’s Compliance and Investigation Group. At that time, Santiago questioned the House prosecutors during Corona’s impeachment trial, asking whether they had withdrawn the articles of impeachment to conduct a trial by publicity.
